newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends touch firmer, treading water.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends touch firmer, treading water.

text.p: COMEX copper ended a dull session barely firmer as the market remained steady ahead of Tuesday's LME stock report.

The market treaded water as traders were reluctant to rely on conflicting expectations regarding Tuesday's stock report. Some thought stocks will continue to show a sharp drop while others refered to talk of more stocks moving from China into Singapore warehouses.
"Starting out today the market looked as if it was going to be relatively exciting, but everyone anticipated more than actually happened," a disappointed broker said.
December COMEX settled 0.80 cent firmer at 93.45 cents, traded 93.70 to 92.00 cents.
LME prices were also loathe to trade in too wide a band ahead of Tuesday's stock report. Some brokers forecast a drop of 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes.
Also on the immediate red metal horizon is Wednesday's LME options declaration which may inject some activity into the market because current prices are within range of some of the key strike prices.
